title: FewRel: A Large-Scale Supervised Few-Shot Relation Classification Dataset with State-of-the-Art Evaluation
reasoning: The paper discusses different types of 'reasoning' (e.g., Simple Pattern, Common-sense Reasoning, Logical Reasoning, Co-reference Reasoning) in the context of relation classification, which refers to the cognitive processes required by the model to perform the task, not an evaluation of religion, morals, or ethics.
